title: rain tree at Dusk
provenance: Acquired by the estate of renowned Singaporean art patron, Khong Leong Soon, in 1987. Subsequently sold to art dealer, Lee Wei Lin, before passing through the collection of Singapore's first prime minister, Yusuf Ishak, between 2002 and 2018. Now part of the Meridian Fine Arts Auctioneers' inventory since 2021.
